title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering a matrix involves adjusting each column (except the intercept) so that its mean is zero. This transformation can affect the interpretation of the intercept term in your model. Consider how this might influence the fitted values.

title: Exploring Fitted Values
text: The fitted values in a linear regression model are the predicted values of the response variable based on the estimated coefficients. Think about how these values relate to the observed data, especially when the data is mean-centered.

title: Mean of Fitted Values
text: If the mean of the observed values $$y$$ is zero, what can you say about the mean of the fitted values in a mean-centered model?

title: Intercept Term in Mean-Centered Data
text: When data is mean-centered, the intercept term in the regression model represents the mean of the response variable. Consider how this affects the relationship between the fitted and observed values.
